content: निरुक्तिः {%f.%} .²1 Derivation, etymological interpretation of words; जरत्कारुनिरुक्तिं त्वं यथावद्वक्तुमर्हसि <ls>Mb. 1. 40. 2</ls>. .²2 (In <ab>Rhet.</ab>) An artificial explanation of the derivation of a word; thus defined:-- निरुक्तिर्योगतो नाम्नामन्यार्थत्वप्रकल्पनम् . ईदृशैश्चरितैर्जाने सत्यं दोषाकरो भवान् .. <ls>Chandr. 5. 168</ls> (where दोषाकरः is equal to दोषाणामाकरः). .²3 (In drama.) communication of an event that has taken place. .²4 <ab>N.</ab> of Yāskaʼs commentary on the Nighaṇṭus.
